group.name: tgsignals – Ethereum
group.description: A small public tgsignals feed for Ethereum. The channel describes algorithmic calls for the New York session that can be auto-traded on the subscriber's own MT4 or MT5 account. tgsignals.com says it posts about 1–2 times a week.
